<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The list footer: a summary line and previous / next page buttons. With `numbered` it shows page numbers (1 … 4
  5 6 … 21), with `moreLabel` a "Load more" button. The current page is a plain element marked
  aria-current="page"; the others are buttons, or links with `pageUrl` (the address of page ｛0｝; `firstUrl` for
  page 1): a disabled previous / next stays a disabled button, without an address. All text comes in through
  props.
-->
<script lang="ts">
export type PagerProps = {
  page: number;
  pages: number;
  summary: string;
  previousLabel: string;
  nextLabel: string;
  numbered?: boolean;
  pageLabel?: string;
  moreLabel?: string;
  pageUrl?: string;
  firstUrl?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Button from "../compose/Button.vue";
import Inline from "../compose/Inline.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import { pageWindow, tpl, urlOf } from "../utils";

const {
  page,
  pages,
  summary,
  previousLabel,
  nextLabel,
  numbered = false,
  pageLabel,
  moreLabel,
  pageUrl,
  firstUrl,
} = defineProps<PagerProps>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ page: [page: number], more: [] }>();
const numbers = computed(() => pageWindow(page, pages));
</script>

<template>
  <Box
    :class="'flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground'"
    data-slot="pager"
  >
    <Inline class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
      <Inline>
        {{ summary }}
      </Inline>
    </Inline>
    <Inline class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
      <Button
        v-if="(moreLabel && (page < pages))"
        variant="outline"
        size="sm"
        type="button"
        @click="() => emit('more')"
      >
        {{ moreLabel }}
      </Button>
      <Button
        variant="outline"
        size="sm"
        layout="icon"
        :aria-label="previousLabel"
        :disabled="(page <= 1)"
        :href="urlOf(((page <= 1) ? undefined : (pageUrl ? ((((page - 1) === 1) && firstUrl) ? firstUrl : tpl(pageUrl, (page - 1))) : undefined)))"
        @click="() => emit('page', (page - 1))"
      >
        <LucideIcon name="chevron-left" :size="16" />
      </Button>
      <template v-if="numbered">
        <template v-for="(n, i) in numbers" :key="(n || tpl('gap{0}', i))">
          <Inline v-if="(n === null)" class="w-8 text-center" data-slot="numbers-row">
            {{ "…" }}
          </Inline>
          <Inline v-else-if="(n === page)"
            :class="'flex h-8 min-w-8 items-center justify-center rounded bg-foreground px-2 font-bold text-background'"
            aria-current="page"
            data-slot="pager-current"
          >
            {{ n }}
          </Inline>
          <Button v-else
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            layout="icon"
            :type="(pageUrl ? undefined : 'button')"
            :aria-label="tpl(pageLabel, n)"
            :href="urlOf((pageUrl ? (((n === 1) && firstUrl) ? firstUrl : tpl(pageUrl, n)) : undefined))"
            @click="() => emit('page', n)"
          >
            {{ n }}
          </Button>
        </template>
      </template>
      <Inline v-else class="min-w-12 text-center font-bold text-foreground">
        {{ page }}
        {{ " / " }}
        {{ pages }}
      </Inline>
      <Button
        variant="outline"
        size="sm"
        layout="icon"
        :aria-label="nextLabel"
        :disabled="(page >= pages)"
        :href="urlOf(((page >= pages) ? undefined : (pageUrl ? ((((page + 1) === 1) && firstUrl) ? firstUrl : tpl(pageUrl, (page + 1))) : undefined)))"
        @click="() => emit('page', (page + 1))"
      >
        <LucideIcon name="chevron-right" :size="16" />
      </Button>
    </Inline>
  </Box>
</template>
